parameters.generator: four-character ASCII tokens; fixed plant positions;50 guaranteed filler tokens; uppercase period separators; z000..z004 reorder with constant per-token CF/DF
parameters.schedule: shuffle every (algorithm,query) block per repetition with fixed seed; reset schedule per dataset

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete block
background_load: ordinary desktop background load; project tests and PDF builds paused during time runs; no CPU isolation
cache: same already prepared corpus and checked index reused; no cold-cache claim

timing_boundaries.build: separate complete public inverted/positional index builds on identical prepared documents; validation included; results checked outside timer
timing_boundaries.query: normalize_query(raw,'phrase') plus public phrase kernel and full fresh dict/list of start positions for BOTH methods
timing_boundaries.block: five identical complete calls retained then checked; equal loop/list overhead; destroy results before next timer
timing_boundaries.excluded: loading, preparation, generation, correctness oracle, summaries, output, memory instrumentation

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3 and IQR; block is one sample; quartiles are not confidence intervals

memory.retained_traced_bytes: current_after_build-current_before_build; tracer begins after corpus preparation
memory.limitations: Python-traced additional allocations, not RSS or serialized size; preparation and preexisting independent oracle containers excluded; no simultaneous production alternative index; no profiling times in raw.csv

interpretation_limits: Every result contains ALL phrase starts; single-word output is larger than inverted word search output.
Length prefixes preserve input corpus but repeated phrases change position counts; length is not fully isolated from result size.
Result-size variants preserve CF/DF, token counts, word lengths and candidate documents but changed token order affects merge progress as well as output allocation.
Real corpus is one unchanged1271-token excerpt; findings do not generalize to large real corpora.

source_fixture.corpus_selection: existing first eight paragraphs as one unchanged document
source_fixture.query_selection: first sentence prefixes at start0; common er; repeated Gregor; absent x999; reversed prefix tokens present but wrong order
